title: BiCaps-DBP: Predicting DNA-binding proteins from protein sequences using Bi-LSTM and a 1D-capsule network.
authors: Mursalim, Muhammad K N; Mengko, Tati L E R; Hertadi, Rukman; Purwarianti, Ayu; Susanty, Meredita
one_liner_zh: 该文用Bi-LSTM和1D胶囊网络从序列预测DNA结合蛋白，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作预测，但未聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合或三维互作机制，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Predicting DNA-binding proteins (DBPs) based solely on primary sequences is one of the most challenging problems in genome annotation. DBPs play a crucial role in various biological processes, including DNA replication, transcription, repair, and splicing. Some DBPs are essential in pharmaceutical research on various human cancers and autoimmune diseases. Existing experimental methods for identifying DBPs are time-consuming and costly. Therefore, developing a rapid and accurate computational technique is necessary to address the issue. This study introduces BiCaps-DBP, a deep learning-based method that improves DBP prediction performance by combining bidirectional long short-term memory with a 1D-capsule network. This study uses three training and independent datasets to evaluate the proposed model's generalizability and robustness. Based on three independent datasets, BiCaps-DBP achieved 1.05%, 5.79% and 0.40% higher accuracies than an existing predictor for PDB2272, PDB186 and PDB20000, respectively. These outcomes indicate that the proposed method is a promising DBP predictor.
abstract_zh: 仅基于一级序列预测DNA结合蛋白（DBPs）是基因组注释中最具挑战性的问题之一。DBPs在多种生物过程中扮演关键角色，包括DNA复制、转录、修复和剪接。一些DBPs在针对多种人类癌症和自身免疫疾病的药物研究中至关重要。现有的识别DBPs的实验方法耗时且成本高昂。因此，开发一种快速且准确的计算技术以解决此问题十分必要。本研究介绍了BiCaps-DBP，一种基于深度学习的方法，通过结合双向长短期记忆网络与一维胶囊网络来提高DBP预测性能。本研究使用三个训练和独立数据集来评估所提出模型的泛化能力和稳健性。基于三个独立数据集，BiCaps-DBP在PDB2272、PDB186和PDB20000上的准确率分别比现有预测器高出1.05%、5.79%和0.40%。这些结果表明，所提出的方法是一种有前景的DBP预测器。
